scope: Tab/Escape observable unique focus transfer inside one explicitly bound window with unchanged complete AT-SPI tree and native recipient. No predicted traversal order, popup-close or general-provider completion.

initial_failure.cause: Integration placed new native focus recheck after KeyPacket construction, changing the X11 request sequence. Existing packet freshness protection correctly refused dispatch. No permissive fallback was added.
initial_failure.fix: Moved the full navigation precheck before constructing the current packet. Original sequence checks, limits and guards unchanged.

navigation_contract.read: Complete same-bus child-index/actual Parent tree, at most128 nodes, depth8 and16KiB cumulative UTF-8 names/text/interfaces; exact bounds remain usable. Facts reject password before name/text/interfaces/descendants. Cycle, foreign, duplicate, private, truncated or ambiguous tree refuses proof.
navigation_contract.baseline: Two identical complete reads bracketed by continuous native WindowBinding guards. Original approved path/ref is the unique enabled, sensitive, showing, visible, focusable focused descendant; root remains active. Store immutable refs, paths, hashes of role/name/text/interfaces and all state bits except FOCUSED.
navigation_contract.permit: Prepare before ready, recheck original complete baseline after exact UUID permit and before current native key packet construction. Original selected-node semantic proof/catalog remains required. No native request can be inserted between final packet construction and emit.
navigation_contract.post: One real key pair only. Original selected node proof/static catalog retained, complete tree double-read again, same identities/text/structure/all other state bits and actual native recipient. Only old focus gone plus one new interactive focus counts as key_verified. Zero focus may wait within original750ms; unchanged, ambiguous, drift or unknown remains unknown without replay.
navigation_contract.not_proven: Observed same-window focus transfer does not prove tab ordering, application-specific next target, popup/window close, submission or arbitrary native child-focus changes. Dynamic/popup-changing trees remain unknown; unsupported/private preflight denies before input.
navigation_contract.lifecycle: Existing worker cleanup and actual key release settlement retained. Cancellation after full press keeps both native connections and original barrier until actual release settles; approvals and SQLite single-use receipts verified for both Tab and Escape.

provider_research.conclusion: Inspected default GTK3/GTK4/Qt AT-SPI attribute implementations do not directly expose a usable native XID. Qt custom attributes are application-specific, not a default profile. No toolkit/PID/title/geometry heuristic or whitelist expansion added.
provider_research.generic_binding_status: Still open; explicit owner-selected native binding or a proven provider contract needs separate product/authorization work.

publication: Local-only checkpoint. Specific remote transfer authorization is still pending; no push or alternative upload.
next: General native/semantic provider association, accurate provider hit availability, application close/submission outcomes, legacy/multiple-root input layouts and Wayland input. Keep entire V2 goal active; full suite after entire implementation freeze.
